title: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Phyrexian who speaks of drowning so one may breathe again.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who promises inevitable defeat to her foes.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor credited by a monument inscription with bringing knowledge.

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: A resistance spymaster who warns of the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor credited with bringing ambition, hostile to Norn's followers.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The figure whose will reigned through Sheoldred's ambition.

entities.name: Geth, Thane of Contracts
entities.description: A Phyrexian thane who mocks those who forget the fine print.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who believed he could still save his love, Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker, Jace's love, now loyal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian power for whose glory Vraska acts.

entities.name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
entities.description: A Phyrexian assassin thane who aims to become the true Father of Machines.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: A growing structure that broke through the Blind Eternities and pierced the world's core.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes broken through by the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: Across which Phyrexian perfection coursed.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor credited with bringing passion.

entities.name: Great Work
entities.description: The Phyrexian project that truly began with Urabrask's passion.

entities.name: Slobad, Iron Goblin
entities.description: A goblin who once fought to save Mirrodin and now fights to remake it.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane Slobad once fought to save.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran who helped Koth design a safehouse against the oil.

entities.name: Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres
entities.description: A Phyrexian who invites his old friends to join the pursuit of perfection.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A Mirran resistance figure who designed a safehouse with Melira.

entities.name: Mirran Safehouse
entities.description: A safehouse that those infected by the oil cannot enter.

events.summary: Jace believes he can still save Vraska, but Vraska uses the moment to strike for Phyrexia.
events.quote: A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.

events.summary: The Invasion Tree breaks through the Blind Eternities, spreading Phyrexian perfection across the Multiverse.
events.quote: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.

events.summary: Koth and Melira design a safehouse the oil-infected cannot cross.
events.quote: Melira helped me design it. Those who are infected by the oil cannot cross the threshold.

relations.quote: For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love.
"For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.
Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain.

relations.note: Designed by Koth with Melira (reverse: Koth created it)
